1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Specification and job responsibility of the Service :- Name of the post – Lab Attendant Qualification – 1,High School graduation (1 0+2) having studied Chemistry and/or Biology to carry out certain routine laboratory tasks. They can be tr ained in tasks, such as sample grinding 5 / 8, sieving/ mixing, sub sampling/media preparation/autoclaving etc. Familiarity with the use of weighing bal ance, pH meter, preparation of reagents with details, such as c hemical names, expiry date, purity of the c hemicals, etc. is essential. 2.The persons supplied by the agency should not have any adverse police records/criminal records against them. The character and antecedents of each incumbent of the service provider will be got verified by the service provider and a certificate to this effect to be submitted to WBPHL, Kolkata before deployment. 3. The service provider will ensure that the personnel deployed are medically fit and will keep a record of t heir medical fitness. The service provider shall immediately withdraw such employees who are not found s uitable by this office for any reasons on receipt of such request. 4. The service provider shall engage necessary number of persons as prescribed in the tender. The said pe rsons engaged by the service provider shall be the employee of the service provider and it shall be the dut y of the service provider to pay their salary every month. The said persons deployed shall not claim any e mployment, compensation, engagement or adsorption in the WBPHL, Kolkata at any time. 5. The service provider’s personnel shall not claim any compensation, benefit, regularization, absorption of service in WBPHL, Kolkata under the provisions of Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 or Contract Labour (Regula tion & Abolition) Act, 1970 or any other act, rules and regulations. Undertaking from the personnel have to be submitted by the service provider to WBPHL Kolkata. 6.The service provider’s personnel shall not divulge any information, details of office, work anytime to any person as these are secret in nature. 7. The service provider’s personnel should be polite, cordial, positive and efficient. Any act of indiscipline o n part of the personnel deployed will not be tolerated. 8.The deployed personnel may be required to sit late and may be called on Saturdays,Sunday and other h olidays, if required. 9. The WBPHL, Kolkata may require the service provider to dismiss or remove from the site of work of pers ons deployed by the service provider found to be incompetent, misconduct. 10.The service provider has to provide photo identity card to the persons deployed by them. 11. The service provider shall ensure proper conduct of persons deployed by them in the office premises a nd enforce prohibition consumption of alcoholic drinks, pan, smoking, loitering without work. 12.The personnel of the service provider shall be paid as per the prevailing wages under the Minimum wag es act 1948 from time to time and also maintain statutory contributions like EPF, ESIC etc. as well as confo rm to prescribed wages/salary as per latest notification/memo of the Labour Commissioner, Govt. of WB. 13. The agency will be wholly responsible for payment of wages to the engaged by it in compliance to all s tatutory obligations under all legislations as applicable to it from time to time including Minimum Wages A ct, Employees Provident Fund, ESI Act etc. and the WBPHL shall not incur any liability for any expenditure whatsoever on the persons employed by the agency on account of any obligation. The agency shall provid e particulars of EPF, ESI deposited in respect of the personnel of its employees engaged for WBPHL, Kolkat a.

14. The service provider shall submit the bill in the first week of the following month in duplicate along wit h the acquaintance sheet, attendance copy, EPF,ESI and GST challans. In case consolidated challans are su bmitted agency shall also submit a certificate that the amount received by the agency against PF,ESI,GST f rom WDRA in respect of the manpower deployed at WBPHL Kolkata in included in the challans submitted a nd have been deposited to the appropriate authority accounts. Incase of delay service provider make pay ment from their end and not to wait for payment from WBPHL. Kolkata . 15. Payment to the service provider would be strictly on the certification by the Public Analyst (food and W ater)/incharge of the laboratory that his/her service is satisfactory. 16.The deployed personnel shall seek prior permission if he/she intends to absent himself/herself from wor k. 17.The service provider shall arrange substitute well in advance incase of the person deployed leave the jo b. 18. The service provider shall be contactable at all the times and message sent by telephone/email/ Fax/s pecial messenger from WBPHL to the service provider. The service provider shall strictly observe the instr uctions issued by WBPHL, Kolkata in fulfillment of contract time to time. 19.The WBPHL, Kolkata shall not be liable for any loss, damage, theft , burglary or robbery of any persons belongings, equipment or vehicles of the personnel of the service provider. 20.The WBPHL Kolkata will maintain an attendance register in respect of the staff deployed at WBPHL, Kol kata on the basis of which wages/remuneration will be paid as per approved rate. 21. The agency shall submit a PBG in favour of “Director, Central Combined Laboratory” which will be released after two months of successful completion of the contract period. 22. On the expiry of the contract period the agency will withdraw all its personnel and clear their dues if an y. In case of any dispute on account of the termination of employment or non-employment of personnel of agency, it shall be entirely the responsibility of the agency to pay and settle the same. 23.In case of any dispute arising in respect of the clauses of the agreement, the matter will be referred to The Director, Central Combined Laboratory, Kolkata and his/her decision shall be final and abiding on both the parties. 24. Participating firms must have prior experience of working with parent, same or auxiliary units in easter n India with a minimum turnover of Rs.15 lakhs per year or more in the last one year. 25. In case of wages/salary is less than Rs.30000/- either challan or professional tax registration document may be accepted. 26. The bidder should have registered regional office in the Kolkata Municipal Corporation area. 27. The period of deployment is Six months. The period of deployment may decrease as per the decision o f the Director CCL. In case of reason/reasons, regarding terms and conditions of the tender, of non-satisfact ory performance of the selected vendor, the period/contract is to terminated by the Director CCL without f urther delay and that is to be abide by the vendor. 28. Total number of personnel (Lab. Attendant) to be deployed is twenty. The number of deployment may i ncrease or decrease any time during the contract period as decided by the Director CCL without givin g an y reason. 29. In case of satisfactory service by the vendor, as to be decided by The Director, CCL, the period of deplo yment may be extended. The period of extension will be decided solely by the Director CCL and it will be fi nal. The number of extension may be more than one time. 30. The specification and job description should be as per the uploaded document titled 'Lab. Attendant'. 31. Commencement of deployment may be defarred as per the decision of the Director, CCL and that will b e considered as final. . 3.
